plan.title: One-Week Low-Sodium Air Fryer Meal Plan
plan.summary: This week emphasizes heart-healthy meals rich in legumes, fresh vegetables, and whole grains prepared with an air fryer without any added salt. Portions are balanced to keep you satisfied with fiber and lean proteins while lighter evening meals support your daily energy goals.

recipes.title: Air-Fried Chickpea and Vegetable Bowl

ingredients.name: bell peppers
ingredients.note: seeded and diced into 2 cm pieces

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine 240 g of drained no-salt-added chickpeas, 150 g of diced zucchini, and 150 g of diced bell peppers with 14 g of extra-virgin olive oil, 1 tsp of salt-free mixed dried herbs, and 1/2 tsp of black pepper until thoroughly coated.
Transfer the seasoned chickpea and vegetable mixture into the air fryer basket in an even layer and cook at 190°C for 8 minutes.
Pull out the air fryer basket, shake thoroughly to redistribute the vegetables and chickpeas, and return to cook at 190°C for an additional 7 minutes until tender and lightly crisped.
Arrange 60 g of fresh baby spinach on a serving plate, spoon the warm air-fried chickpea and vegetable mixture over the top, and finish with the juice of half a lemon.

tips: Pat the chickpeas dry with a kitchen towel before tossing in oil to help them brown evenly in the basket.
recipes.why: This dish contains no-salt-added chickpeas, zucchini, bell peppers, baby spinach, and salt-free herbs without any added salt.
recipes.evidence: Adults should aim to consume at least 25 grams of naturally-occurring dietary fiber each day [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Air-Fried Salmon with Roasted Vegetables

ingredients.name: salmon fillets
ingredients.note: skin-on or skinless, about 140 g each

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.note: peeled and sliced into 1 cm rounds

steps.text: In a bowl, toss 250 g of sliced carrots and 300 g of sliced zucchini with 20 g of extra-virgin olive oil, 1 tsp of salt-free mixed dried herbs, and 1/4 tsp of black pepper.
Season 2 salmon fillets on both sides with the remaining 1/4 tsp of black pepper and the grated zest of 1 lemon.
Place the salmon fillets in the center of the air fryer basket and arrange the seasoned carrot and zucchini slices around the fish in a single layer, then cook at 180°C for 6 minutes.
Carefully turn the vegetables and salmon fillets halfway through cooking, then resume air-frying at 180°C for another 6 minutes until the salmon flakes with a fork and the vegetables are tender.

Squeeze half of the lemon over the cooked salmon fillets and vegetables; serve 1 salmon fillet with half of the vegetables immediately, and transfer the remaining 1 salmon fillet and vegetables into an airtight container to refrigerate once cooled.

tips: Cut the carrot rounds slightly thinner than the zucchini so both vegetables become tender at the same time.
recipes.why: This meal contains salmon fillets, carrots, and zucchini seasoned with lemon, black pepper, and herbs with no added salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults, the World Health Organization recommends consuming less than 2,000 mg of sodium per day, which is equivalent to less than 5 g of salt [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Chilled Salmon and Cannellini Bean Salad

ingredients.name: Salmon fillets
ingredients.note: cooked, chilled and flaked (from Mon dinner)

steps.text: Drain 240 g no-salt-added cannellini beans in a colander and rinse thoroughly under cool running water.
steps.then: Shake off excess water and transfer to a large mixing bowl.

steps.text: Add 60 g fresh baby spinach and 200 g chilled leftover roasted carrots and zucchini to the mixing bowl.
Gently flake 1 leftover chilled roasted salmon fillet into bite-sized pieces and place into the salad bowl.
In a small cup, whisk together 15 g lemon juice, 14 g extra-virgin olive oil, and 0.5 g black pepper, then pour over the salad and toss gently to coat before serving.

tips: Keep the salmon and vegetables refrigerated until just before mixing to maintain a crisp, chilled salad texture.
recipes.why: This salad combines fish, no-salt-added beans, and vegetables with no added salt, seasoned with fresh lemon juice and black pepper.
recipes.evidence: WHO recommends an intake of less than 2,000 mg of sodium per day for adults, which is equivalent to less than 5 g of salt [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Air-Crisped Chicken Breast with Broccoli and Carrots

steps.text: Pat 450 g chicken breasts dry with paper towels, then rub evenly with 6 g minced garlic, 13 g extra-virgin olive oil, 2 g mixed dried herbs, and 0.5 g black pepper.
In a large bowl, combine 400 g broccoli florets and 350 g carrot batons with the remaining 14 g extra-virgin olive oil, 2 g mixed dried herbs, and 0.5 g black pepper, tossing until evenly coated.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C. Place the seasoned chicken breasts in the air fryer basket in a single layer and cook at 190°C for 10 minutes, turning halfway.

Add the tossed broccoli florets and carrot batons around the chicken in the air fryer basket and cook at 190°C for 8 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until the chicken is thoroughly cooked and vegetables are tender.
Plate 1 cooked chicken breast along with half of the roasted broccoli and carrots to serve.
steps.then: Transfer the remaining 1 chicken breast and roasted vegetables to an airtight container, let cool completely, and store in the refrigerator.

tips: Cut the carrots into thin batons so they soften in the same cooking time as the broccoli florets.
recipes.why: This meal provides lean chicken breast and generous portions of broccoli and carrots prepared in the air fryer with garlic, dried herbs, and olive oil with no added salt.
recipes.evidence: Everyone older than 10 years of age should aim for at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables per day [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Sliced Chicken and Quinoa Salad

ingredients.name: cooked chicken breast
ingredients.note: leftover from Tuesday dinner, sliced cold

steps.text: Rinse 70 g of quinoa in a fine-mesh sieve under cold running water, then transfer to a small saucepan on the stovetop with 150 ml of water and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
steps.then: Cover the saucepan tightly and reduce heat to low.

steps.text: Simmer the quinoa on low heat for 15 minutes until the water is completely absorbed, then remove from the heat and let rest covered for 5 minutes.
steps.then: Fluff gently with a fork and transfer to a shallow bowl to cool.

steps.text: Combine 60 g of fresh baby spinach and 100 g of halved cherry tomatoes in a large salad bowl.
steps.then: Add the cooled cooked quinoa to the bowl.

steps.text: Arrange 150 g of cold sliced leftover cooked chicken breast on top of the quinoa and vegetable mixture.
steps.then: Drizzle with 10 ml of extra-virgin olive oil and 10 ml of apple cider vinegar.

steps.text: Season with a pinch of freshly cracked black pepper and toss gently to coat evenly before serving.

tips: Rinsing quinoa before simmering removes naturally occurring saponins that can cause bitterness.
Spread the cooked quinoa on a plate to cool it quickly before tossing with the fresh spinach.
recipes.why: This meal provides unrefined whole grains from quinoa, leafy greens and cherry tomatoes, lean protein from leftover chicken, and uses apple cider vinegar and cracked pepper instead of added salt.
recipes.evidence: Everyone older than 10 years of age should aim for a daily intake of at least 25 grams of naturally-occurring dietary fibre as found in foods [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Crispy Air-Fried Tofu and Chickpea Medley

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.note: pressed dry, cut into 2 cm cubes

ingredients.name: chickpeas, no salt added
ingredients.note: rinsed, drained, and patted thoroughly dry

steps.text: Pat 400 g of firm tofu dry with clean paper towels to remove surface moisture, then slice into 2 cm bite-sized cubes.
steps.then: Place the cubed tofu into a large mixing bowl.

steps.text: Add 400 g of drained, dried no-salt-added chickpeas, 2 finely minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp of salt-free mixed dried herbs, 1/2 tsp of black pepper, and 20 ml of extra-virgin olive oil to the bowl.
steps.then: Gently toss the mixture until the tofu cubes and chickpeas are evenly coated with herbs and oil.

steps.text: Spread the seasoned tofu and chickpea mixture into the air fryer basket in a single, even layer.
steps.then: Insert the basket into the air fryer.

steps.text: Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 16 minutes, pausing at the 8-minute mark to shake the basket vigorously so all sides crisp evenly.
steps.then: Check that the edges are golden and crisp when cooking finishes.

steps.text: Transfer the hot medley to a serving platter, squeeze the juice of 1 lemon over the top, and divide into two equal portions.
steps.then: Serve 1 portion immediately, and transfer the remaining portion to an airtight container to refrigerate once cooled.

tips: Thoroughly drying both the tofu cubes and chickpeas ensures they crisp instead of steaming in the air fryer.
Store the reserved second portion in a covered container in the refrigerator.
recipes.why: This dish centers on plant-based protein and legumes from firm tofu and no-salt-added chickpeas, seasoned purely with aromatic garlic, salt-free dried herbs, and fresh lemon juice without any added salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults, WHO recommends less than 2000 mg/day of sodium (equivalent to less than 5 g/day salt), or just under a teaspoon [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

ingredients.name: bell pepper

recipes.title: Air-Fried Vegetable and Ricotta Whole-Wheat Pasta

steps.text: On the stovetop, bring a pot of water to a boil, add 75 g whole-wheat pasta, cook for 10 minutes until tender, and drain.
In a bowl, toss 150 g sliced zucchini, 60 g chopped yellow onions, and 100 g cherry tomatoes with 10 g extra-virgin olive oil and 2 g salt-free mixed dried herbs.
Transfer the seasoned vegetables to the air fryer basket and roast at 195°C for 12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
Combine the drained warm pasta and roasted vegetables in a serving bowl, gently fold in 40 g ricotta using a spatula, and season with 1 g black pepper.

tips: Reserve a splash of hot pasta cooking water if a looser sauce consistency is preferred.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu and Cannellini Bean Skillet Bowl

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.note: pressed and cut into 2 cm cubes

steps.text: On the stovetop, bring a small saucepan with 150 ml water and 60 g brown rice to a boil, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until the water is absorbed.
In a bowl, toss 150 g cubed firm tofu with 5 g extra-virgin olive oil and 2 g salt-free mixed dried herbs.
Place the tofu cubes in the air fryer basket in a single layer and cook at 200°C for 15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through until golden and crisp.

In a skillet on the stovetop, heat the remaining 5 g extra-virgin olive oil and 3 g minced garlic over medium heat, add 60 g baby spinach and 130 g drained cannellini beans, and stir with a spatula for 2 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Spoon the cooked brown rice into a bowl, arrange the warm spinach and beans alongside, top with the crispy air-fried tofu, and finish with 1 g black pepper.

tips: Patting the tofu dry with a clean paper towel before seasoning yields the crispiest result in the air fryer.

recipes.evidence: WHO recommends that adults consume at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables per day [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].
